scripts.text:
[Tine]
The legend says that on 14th February... on the Day of Saint Valentine...
Only in Run-Midgard kingdom...
scripts.translation:
[蒂内]
传说每到2月14日...也就是情人节...
在卢恩·米德加兹王国...

scripts.text:
[Tine]
Some married chocolate lovers almost double their experience at trainings!
But everything isn't so simply...
scripts.translation:
[蒂内]
有些喜欢巧克力的已婚人士，在训练时能获得将近双倍的经验值！
不过，事情可没那么简单...

scripts.text: Wow! Tell me more!
scripts.translation: 哇！告诉我更多！

scripts.text: Marri... what?
scripts.translation: 结...结婚？

scripts.text:
[Tine]
Are you a single?
Today is a great date to ask your beloved half for marriage!
scripts.translation:
[蒂内]
你是单身吗？
今天是向你的另一半求婚的好日子！

scripts.text:
[Tine]
The Marriage fee is ridiculous low these days!
scripts.translation:
[蒂内]
现在的结婚费用低得离谱！

scripts.text:
[Tine]
The magic effect possesses only handmade chocolate from grand-grand-grand-whoever recipes!
scripts.translation:
[蒂内]
只有用曾曾曾...不知传了多少代的祖传秘方做出的手工巧克力，才有这种魔法效果！

scripts.text:
[Tine]
It being known that Black Handmade Chocolate works on married guys... And the White one on the married girls!
If you lose your wedding ring... then alas, it won't work on you.
scripts.translation:
[蒂内]
听说黑色手工巧克力对已婚男性有效，白色手工巧克力则对已婚女性有效！
要是弄丢了结婚戒指...唉，那就没用了。

scripts.text:
[Tine]
On having a Chocolate, you should put off your ring then... put it back... And if your partner is online, then magic would last till the next hour!
scripts.translation:
[蒂内]
拿到巧克力后，你应该摘下戒指...然后再戴上...如果你的伴侣在线，魔法效果将持续到下一个整点！

scripts.text:
[Tine]
Rumors bark that guys and gals have +50% EXP bonuses on FIVE different races of the monsters... Excluding bloody bosses, of course.
scripts.translation:
[蒂内]
据说男女双方打五种不同种族的魔物时，能获得50%的经验值加成...当然，那些该死的Boss可不算。

scripts.text:
[Tine]
There's a famous confectioner in the Castle of Prontera! He's the one you need.
scripts.translation:
[蒂内]
普隆德拉城堡里有一位著名的糖果师！你需要找的就是他。

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
Guess what I've got?
A tasty treat not easily found in Midgard....
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
猜猜我有什么？
在米德加兹可不容易找到这样的美味...

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
Chocolate!
That's right, don't you love chocolate.... I do.
And you are in luck, because I'm selling them for only 5,000 zeny a piece!
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
巧克力！
没错，你喜欢巧克力吧...反正我喜欢。
你可走运了，我这里每块只卖5,000 Zeny！

scripts.text: I want some chocolate!
scripts.translation: 我想要巧克力！

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
You don't want any chocolate?
I'm telling you! You'll regret it!
You better get some now... you won't come across Chocolate like this ever again!
Think it over and visit me again sometime.
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
你不想买巧克力吗？
我告诉你！你会后悔的！
你最好现在买一些...你再也遇不到像这样的巧克力了！
好好考虑一下，改天再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
Hah!
I knew it!
But I can't sell you more than 5 at once....but, if you really need more....
you can come back again.
So how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
哈！我就知道！
不过，我一次最多只能卖5块。想多买一些的话，再来找我就行...
你要几块？

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
There you go!
You can give that to someone as a gift, or enjoy it yourself!
Mmm....sweet chocolate...
Visit me anytime...!
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
给你！
你可以把它作为礼物送给别人，或者自己享用！
嗯...甜甜的巧克力...
随时欢迎再来...

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
I'm sorry but I can't give you that many.
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
抱歉，我不能给你那么多。

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
I'm sorry but it seems you can't afford to buy these of me.
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
抱歉，看来你买不起我的巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
You know what? The chocolate that my boyfriend sells are from me!
I made them by myself. Now I need some Milk for my special White Chocolate.
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
你知道吗？我男朋友卖的巧克力都是我亲手做的！
现在我需要一些牛奶，来做特制的白色情人巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
You know ... In certain countries, there's a tradition of presenting chocolates to a person that you love...
They call it ^3355FFValentine's Day^000000.
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
你知道吗...在某些国家，有向心爱的人赠送巧克力的传统...
他们称之为^3355FF情人节^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
So I gave him my delicious chocolate...
And then he made me cook a lot more...
And now he is selling them to everyone.
I guess he really enjoyed it.
But, I do feel good when people buy something I have made.
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
我把自己做的美味巧克力送给了他...
结果他让我又做了好多，现在还把它们卖给大家。
看来他真的很喜欢。
不过，看到有人愿意买我做的东西，我也挺开心的。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
It would be great if you bought some too...
I will be making white chocolates for a while so...
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
如果你也买一些就好了...
我最近会一直做白色巧克力，所以...

scripts.text: I want some white chocolate!
scripts.translation: 我想要一些白色巧克力！

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
You don't like white chocolate?
Then buy some Stephen's black one!
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
你不喜欢白色巧克力？
那就买斯蒂芬的黑色巧克力吧！

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
I can't sell you more than 5 at once....but, if you really need more....
you can come back again.
So how many do you want? 1 portion is 4500z + 1 Milk.
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
我一次最多只能卖5块。想多买一些的话，再来找我就行...
你要几块？每份需要4,500 Zeny和1瓶牛奶。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
There you go!
You can give that to someone as a gift, or enjoy it yourself!
Mmm... sweet chocolate...
Visit me anytime...!
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
给你！
可以送人，也可以自己享用！
嗯...甜甜的巧克力...
随时欢迎再来...！

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
I'm sorry but I can't give you that many.
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
抱歉，我不能给你那么多。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
I'm sorry but it seems you can't afford to buy these of me.
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
抱歉，看来你买不起我的巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
You need {0} Milk for {1} portions of my special White Chocolate...
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
想买{1}份特制白色情人巧克力，需要{0}瓶牛奶...

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Yes? What can I cook for you?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
嗯？想让我给你做什么？

scripts.text: Black handmade Chocolate, please
scripts.translation: 请给我黑色的手工巧克力

scripts.text: I want a White handmade Chocolate...
scripts.translation: 我想要白色的手工巧克力...

scripts.text: I'm lost, sorry to bother you.
scripts.translation: 我迷路了，抱歉打扰

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Well, I just might be able to fulfill your needs...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
嗯，我或许能满足你的需求...

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
I'm sorry you do not have enough Chocolate Bars to do this.
They say Stephen from Alberta used to sell good Chocolate.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
抱歉，你的巧克力棒数量不足，无法进行制作。
听说艾尔贝塔的斯蒂芬以前卖过很好的巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
I'm sorry you do not have enough Chocolate Bars to do this.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
抱歉，你的巧克力棒数量不足，无法进行制作。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
You got 3 pieces of pure chocolate I see.
Give them to me...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
我看到你有3块纯巧克力。
把它们给我...

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Ok, now I will only create my special handmade chocolates if you promise to use it wisely.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
好，不过你得答应我好好使用它，我才会给你做特制手工巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
....Hmmmmmm.....
Well...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
...嗯...
好吧...

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Here.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
给你。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Here.
I hope you give it to someone special, because its a special chocolate.
As you know... only I can create this.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
给你。
我希望你把它送给特别的人，因为这是特别的巧克力。
你也知道...只有我能做出这种巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
请享用。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Well, I just might be able to fulfill your needs...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
嗯，我或许能满足你的需求...

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
I'm sorry you do not have enough White Chocolate Bars to do this.
They say Jainie from Alberta used to sell good White Chocolate.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
抱歉，你的白色情人巧克力数量不足，无法进行制作。
听说艾尔贝塔的杰妮以前卖过很好的白色情人巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
I'm sorry you do not have enough White Chocolate Bars to do this.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
抱歉，你的白色情人巧克力数量不足，无法进行制作。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
You got 3 pieces of pure white chocolate I see.
Give them to me...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
我看到你有3块纯白色巧克力。
把它们给我...

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Ok, now I will only create my special handmade chocolates if you promise to use it wisely.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
好，不过你得答应我好好使用它，我才会给你做特制手工巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
....Hmmmmmm.....
Well...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
...嗯...
好吧...

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Here.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
给你。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Here.
I hope you give it to someone special, because its a special chocolate.
As you know... only I can create this.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
给你。
我希望你把它送给特别的人，因为这是特别的巧克力。
你也知道...只有我能做出这种巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
请享用。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Oh.. well, if you want me to make some of my special handmade Chocolate....
You will need to give me at least ^0000FF 3 Chocolates^000000 or ^0000FF 3 White Chocolates^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
哦...想让我做特制手工巧克力的话...
至少要给我^0000FF 3块巧克力^000000或^0000FF 3块白色情人巧克力^000000。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
That's right, only ^0000FF 3 Chocolates^000000 or ^0000FF 3 White Chocolates^000000.
Bring them to me and you'll get what you came for.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
没错，就是 ^0000FF 3 块巧克力^000000 或 ^0000FF 3 块白色情人巧克力^000000。
把它们带给我，你就能得到你想要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
See You.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
再见。
